part.text:
Done. The route now builds as `◐ (Partial Prerender)` with a static shell containing `

Dashboard

` and skeletons. Changes: - `app/data.ts` — new shared `getDashboardData()` wrapped in React `cache()`, so the single fetch is deduped across all three components per request. - `app/page.tsx` — no longer async; renders instantly as the static shell with each dynamic section in its own `` boundary so they stream independently. - `CardStats`/`RevenueChart`/`LatestInvoices` — converted to async server components that fetch their own data, each with an exported skeleton fallback. Previously the top-level `await` blocked everything, so the prerendered shell was just the `loading.tsx` spinner. Verified with `tsc --noEmit` and `next build` (shell HTML confirmed to contain the heading + fallbacks).
